title: Security of Personal Data in Government Agencies
summary: Mandates technical, physical, and organizational security measures for processing personal data in government information systems, including mandatory encryption (AES-256) of SPI at rest and in transit, storage segregation, and continuous access audit trails.

title: Personal Data Breach Management
summary: Outlines mandatory procedures for security incident management, containment protocols, and mandatory notification to the NPC and affected data subjects within 72 hours of personal data breach discovery.

title: Registration of Personal Data Processing Systems
summary: Requirements and technical guidelines for registering automated data processing systems and appointing designated Data Protection Officers (DPOs).

title: Guidelines on Compliance Checks
summary: Rules and procedures for on-site visits, privacy audits, compliance orders, and statutory investigations conducted by the Commission.

title: Data Sharing Agreements
summary: Rules and mandatory safeguards for inter-agency data sharing agreements (DSAs), multi-office data exchange, API authentication, and tenant isolation, amending Circular 16-02.

title: Data Subject Rights
summary: Operational workflows and response timeliness for handling citizen requests for access, rectification, erasure, and blocking of personal data.

title: Guidelines on Administrative Fines
summary: Schedule and framework for imposing administrative penalties, classifications of grave and major infractions, and fine computation matrices for DPA violations.

title: Registration of Personal Data Processing System, Notification Regarding Automated Decision-Making or Profiling, Designation of DPO, and NPC Seal of Registration
summary: Mandatory DPS registration thresholds, DPO accreditation procedures, notifications regarding automated profiling algorithms, and the NPC Seal of Registration guidelines.

title: Guidelines on Identification Cards
summary: Protections and data minimization standards regarding the photocopying, scanning, collection, and verification of government and personal identity cards.

title: Guidelines on Consent
summary: Standards for freely given, specific, and informed consent in online portals, privacy notices, and public sector statutory processing authorities.

title: Guidelines on Legitimate Interest
summary: Criteria and procedural tests (Purpose, Necessity, and Balancing Tests) for invoking Legitimate Interest as a lawful ground for processing personal data.

title: Guidelines on the Processing of Personal Data through Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) Systems
summary: Governs public and municipal video surveillance, retention limits, signage requirements, and pixelation/masking of third-party bystanders.
